# Fact Ledger: Session 1 Where the water goes

Format: `[ID] | fact | type | slide`

## 1. Extras (slides 7-10)

- [W01-001] | Transpiration: plants release water vapour through their leaves; evaporation and transpiration together are called evapotranspiration | Definition | 7
- [W01-002] | About 97% of Earth's water is salt water in the oceans | Statistic | 8
- [W01-003] | Runoff: water flowing over land into streams and rivers | Definition | 9
- [W01-004] | Infiltration: water soaking into the ground and becoming groundwater | Definition | 9
- [W01-005] | Sublimation: ice turns directly into vapour without becoming liquid first | Definition | 10
